reason: Root selects the exact complete existing-carrier source/receiving-scope relation described in each already selected application. Explicit native guards bind each independently existing actual receiver to the actual selected source owner ID; a complete nonempty pre-discovery inventory is required, not a source-chosen subset. content.application_contract: For this explicitly bounded application, select neon-source illumination on an independently identified existing illuminating light and its independently identified existing illuminated receiver. Change the declared source type to neon. Preserve their established illumination relation and receiving scope. This selection does not add a light fixture, visible neon sign, text, person, object, place, color, intensity or direction. For the explicitly selected existing-carrier application, independently select the actual existing illumination source and a complete, nonempty, flat inventory of all existing actual receivers in its established receiving scope, grounded in the complete reviewed request inputs before discovery. This is the existing receiving scope named above, not a candidate-chosen subset or a newly created aggregate object. Each actual receiver must already receive illumination from that same actual selected source; bind each receiver lighting.received_from fact to that actual source owner ID. Preserve that relation and the exact complete receiver membership. Apply every declared lighting effect to the same source with all inventory members as receivers. Select owners independently without requiring a fixed primary/main or light-role address. Missing source, missing/wrong relation, absent receiver, incomplete or unknown membership, or a substituted subset requires review and cannot fall back to another owner. The desired selected source type, modifier, quality, phase treatment or scene time is an effect and must not be pre-required as an existing value.
